subject: Mental Models
title: The Golden Mean
description: A quick win: understand The Golden Mean.

hook.text: A soldier charges alone into battle. Another hides and refuses to fight. One is reckless. The other is a coward.

buildup.text: Aristotle's Golden Mean says virtue is the midpoint between two extremes.

discovery.text: Aristotle outlined this in Nicomachean Ethics around 340 BC.

twist.text: The mean is not a mathematical average. It shifts based on the person and situation.

climax.text: When developing a virtue, identify both extremes and aim for the balance point.

punchline.text: Virtue is the balance between two extremes.

quiz.question: What is Aristotle's Golden Mean?
options: Virtue as the midpoint between deficiency and excess
The mathematical center of any scale
